title: stacked plot test
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate a stacked area chart with library circulation data and custom month labels.

**dataset → plot → chart → context_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAxis](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAxis.html) — axis.
- [vtkChartXY](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkChartXY.html) — chart xy.
- [vtkColorSeries](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorSeries.html) — color series.
- [vtkContextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextActor.html) — context actor.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkPlotStacked](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlotStacked.html) — plot stacked.
- [vtkStringArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringArray.html) — string array.
- [vtkTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTable.html) — table.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
